cards.ex: She's growing out her pixie cut; it's at that awkward in-between stage.
cards.exUz: U o'zining qisqa soch turmagini o'stirmoqda; hozir noqulay o'rtadagi bosqichda.
cards.uzDef: Sochni qisqa kesgandan keyin, uzunroq bo'lishi uchun o'stirish.

cards.ex: George Clooney is considered a silver fox by many women.
cards.exUz: Jorj Kluni ko'plab ayollar tomonidan kumush tulki deb hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Sochlari oqargan, ammo hali ham jozibali erkak.

cards.ex: She's starting to get a few fine lines around her eyes.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'zlari atrofida bir nechta mayda ajinlar paydo bo'lyapti.
cards.uzDef: Yuzdagi mayda, ingichka ajinlar.

cards.ex: She always has such a fresh face, even without makeup.
cards.exUz: Uning doim yuzi shunday yangi ko'rinadi, hatto makiyajsiz ham.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va sog'lom ko'rinadigan yuz.

cards.ex: She really turned up for the party; her dress was stunning.
cards.exUz: U partiyaga juda chiroyli libosda keldi; uning ko'ylagi hayratlanarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda libos va tashqi ko'rinishingizni yanada zamonaviyroq qilmoq.

cards.ex: She has an eye for design; everything she puts together looks amazing.
cards.exUz: U dizaynni juda yaxshi biladi; u birga qo'ygan hamma narsa ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zallikni, uslubni yoki sifatni aniqlay olish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: She maintains a youthful glow by drinking lots of water and getting enough sleep.
cards.exUz: U ko'p suv ichish va etarli uxlash orqali yoshlik nurini saqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yosh va sog'lom terining tabiiy nuri.

cards.ex: He's always so well-groomed, even on casual days.
cards.exUz: U doim juda ozoda, hatto kundalik kunlarda ham.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga yaxshi qaragan, toza va tartibli ko'rinadigan.

cards.ex: If you want to be taken seriously in this industry, you need to dress the part.
cards.exUz: Agar siz ushbu sohada jiddiy qabul qilinishni istasangiz, siz mos kiyinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatga, roliga yoki kasbiga mos keladigan kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: She added a touch of red lipstick to brighten her look.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishini yoritish uchun bir oz qizil lab bo'yog'ini qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Oz miqdorda qo'shilgan narsa.

cards.ex: Good looks definitely run in the family; her sister is stunning too.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi ko'rinishlar oilada nasldan-naslga o'tadi; uning singlisi ham juda go'zal.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarida uchraydigan xususiyat.

cards.ex: I need to get my beauty sleep tonight; I have a big day tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechasi go'zallik uqusimni olishim kerak; ertaga muhim kunim bor.
cards.uzDef: Go'zal ko'rinish uchun zarur bo'lgan uqu.

cards.ex: He's aging like fine wine; he looks better now than he did years ago.
cards.exUz: U vino kabi qarimoqda; hozir u bir necha yil oldingidan ko'ra yaxshiroq ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yaxshilanib boradigan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's a real head-turner; everyone stares when she walks into a room.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy e'tiborni tortuvchi; xonaga kirganda hamma unga qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va e'tiborni jalb qiluvchi odam.

cards.ex: He scrubs up well; he looks completely different in a suit.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yuvinadi; kostyumda butunlay boshqacha ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy ko'rinishdan keyin yaxshi ko'rinish uchun o'zini yaxshilab tozalash.

cards.ex: That dress really flatters her figure; it accentuates her curves.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak uning qomatini chindan ham ko'rsatadi; u uning egri chiziqlarini ta'kidlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qomatni yaxshi ko'rsatadigan kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: While outer beauty is nice, it's inner beauty that truly matters.
cards.exUz: Tashqi go'zallik yaxshi bo'lsa-da, aslida ichki go'zallik muhim.
cards.uzDef: Faqat tashqi ko'rinishga asoslangan go'zallik.

cards.ex: She gave him an alluring look that he couldn't resist.
cards.exUz: U unga qarshilik qila olmaydigan jozibali nigoh berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqarli va jozibali ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She has a radiant complexion, probably because she drinks so much water.
cards.exUz: Uning terisi nurli, ehtimol u juda ko'p suv ichgani uchun.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va nurli ko'rinadigan teri.

cards.ex: She always has such a put-together look, even when she's just running errands.
cards.exUz: U doim juda to'liq ko'rinishga ega, hatto shunchaki ishlarni bajarayotganda ham.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi rejalashtirilgan va muvofiqlashtirilgan tashqi ko'rinish.

cards.ex: People are often drawn to her exotic beauty; she looks like she could be from anywhere.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'pincha uning ekzotik go'zalligiga qiziqishadi; u har qanday joydan kelganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: G'ayrioddiy va jozibali ko'rinadigan go'zallik.

cards.ex: She decided to glam up for her date tonight.
cards.exUz: U bugun oqshom uchrashuvi uchun bezanishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zalroq va jozibaliroq ko'rinish uchun bezanmoq.

cards.ex: Makeup can be used to accentuate your best features.
cards.exUz: Makiyaj yuzingizning eng yaxshi xususiyatlarini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi ko'rinish uchun yuz xususiyatlarini ajratib ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: She's aging gracefully; she embraces her wrinkles.
cards.exUz: U chiroyli qarimoqda; u ajinlarini qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlarni qabul qilib, sog'lom va chiroyli ko'rinishda qarish.

cards.ex: She always goes for a classic look with simple dresses and elegant jewelry.
cards.exUz: U har doim oddiy ko'ylaklar va nafis taqinchoqlar bilan klassik ko'rinishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon modadan qolmaydigan, zamonaviy ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She dressed to kill for her high school reunion.
cards.exUz: U o'rta maktab bitiruvchilarining uchrashuvi uchun juda chiroyli kiyindi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va jozibali ko'rinish uchun kiyinish.

cards.ex: There's a striking resemblance between her and her mother when she was younger.
cards.exUz: U bilan onasi o'rtasida yoshligida ajoyib o'xshashlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Ikki kishi o'rtasidagi juda kuchli o'xshashlik.

cards.ex: She prefers a natural look and doesn't wear much makeup.
cards.exUz: U tabiiy ko'rinishni afzal ko'radi va ko'p makiyaj qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Makiyajsiz yoki minimal makiyaj bilan tabiiy ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's getting all done up for her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yi uchun to'liq pardoz qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Maxsus tadbir uchun makiyaj qilish, kiyinish va soch turmaklash.

cards.ex: She was a total knockout at the party; everyone was staring at her.
cards.exUz: U partiyada so'zsiz go'zal edi; hamma unga qarab turardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va hayratlanarli odam.
